name: at-most-three-reviewers
expectation: ADL business rule AssignmentValidity, clause "the proposal has fewer than three active assignments": no proposal ever holds more than three active (non-revoked) assignments.

claim.clause: the proposal has fewer than three active assignments

boundary.statement: AssignReviewer — every write in src/** that creates an ACTIVE assignment (any status but revoked), and every runtime entry point that reaches one, in one Quorum process over one store.
includes: an UPDATE of rev_assignment that moves a revoked assignment back to an active status
every call, in src/**, of the function holding such a write

excludes.what: the demo seed's calls of assignReviewer (src/seed.ts)
excludes.why: demo data, never run when NODE_ENV=production; it calls the same guarded function

excludes.what: several Quorum processes writing one store at once
excludes.why: one process per store is the deployment model (LocalDevelopment binding); the store trigger is the defence there and is observed statically (store-bound-trigger), not executed across processes
demo 036: the claim narrowed to sequential requests

scope.discovery: Lex src/**: every INSERT/REPLACE INTO rev_assignment, and every UPDATE of rev_assignment that can move a revoked status to an active one, is a write; the named function holding each write is found, and every call of it in src/** is an entry point (an HTTP registration is named by method and URL). Non-literal SQL must resolve, else the scope is incomplete.

assumptions.statement: An active assignment is any rev_assignment row whose status is not revoked (assigned, accepted, overdue, completed): the model's "active assignments", in stored values.

Cases set up their world (accounts, a published call, an eligible proposal, the first assignments) through the implementation's own harness and services. The act under test — the HTTP route — and the state read — rev_assignment — are the verifier's.

The `reached` paths are what V8 precise coverage reports executing during the case (function call counts), mapped to the write sites by their enclosing function: observed by the runtime, not declared.

checks.statement: the writes that create an active assignment, and their entry points, are all known: at least one discovered, nothing unresolved
with no active assignment, the route assigns a verified reviewer: one active after
with three assigned and one revoked, the route assigns a fourth reviewer: a revoked assignment does not count, and three are active after
with two active, the route assigns the third: the bound itself is reachable
with three active, the route refuses the fourth, and three remain active. Counts only when its control, third-assigned, passed on the route
with three ACCEPTED assignments, the route refuses another: an accepted assignment is active. Counts only when its control, first-assigned, passed on the route
assignmentEligibility refuses at REVIEWERS_PER_PROPOSAL (3) active, and assignReviewer checks it before its write
the store refuses a fourth active assignment itself (trigger rev_assignment_at_most_three)

violations.statement: the bound is not enforced on the write path: a fourth active assignment is admitted
the bound is off by one: the comparison admits a fourth active assignment and refuses only a fifth
what counts as active is misread: accepted assignments are not counted, so a proposal with three accepted assignments admits a fourth

challenges.statement: the panel-full check and the store trigger are both removed: nothing on the write path bounds the count
the bound compares with > instead of >=, in the service and in the trigger: a fourth is admitted, a fifth refused
the count of active assignments reads status = assigned, in the service and in the trigger: accepted assignments stop counting
